usedFor: Cal ID holds your bookings, and Slack tells the team about each one through “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Created” in Cal ID, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Every new booking posts to a channel, so the team knows before the meeting happens.

watchOut: A post to a Slack channel waits for your approval, so a busy booking day means many posts to approve.
